paragraphs: Rav Se'uram, Rava's brother, Bava Metzia 73b. When Rava was dying, he entreated the Angel of Death not to pain him. After death Rava appeared to him, saying his pain was only like bloodletting, end of Mo'ed Katan 28a. Rav Safra was his son.
